_about: The one place the site's progress is set. The server reads it on every request and fills the status pill and its menu, the home page figure, the research banner, its progress bar and the phase list. Phase states follow from the weeks: done when a phase ends by weeks_done, under way when it starts by code_ready_to, otherwise not started. Change the numbers and the notes here, set 'updated', and nothing else in the site needs editing. tests/test_site_status.py checks it.
headline: All benchmark runs complete · evidence gate next
summary: Data, failure model, real-trace measurement, a validated simulator, policies, theory and a frozen protocol are done. All 528 cells are run (19,140 runs): 30 of 30 registered comparisons win, and the fresh-seed replication agrees. Avoidance is confirmed on fresh seeds. Results are simulated and preliminary until the evidence gate is signed.
